name: Deepen where the click is
governance: A sprint is a BODY OF WORK, not a duration. Completeness beats fitting a point budget. Every item is presented as CLAIM + EVIDENCE + LIVE LINK. DONE MEANS SHIPPED. A definition of done is never narrowed after the sprint starts. OWNER DECISION 02 Sept 2026: full scope approved, nothing cut - the FIFTH consecutive sprint in which the CEO flagged items and the owner kept every one. CONCURRENCY IS THE DEFAULT: one worktree per concurrent item, dispatch together. ⚠ SPRINT 05'S LESSON, BINDING HERE: it scoped 28 items and dispatched 14, so half the sprint never ran. This sprint is scoped to 10 items deliberately - the constraint is dispatch capacity, not ambition, and the fix is to dispatch ALL of it.
theme: Sprint 05 shipped six document-intent articles and fixed the front page; the thesis that document intent converts ~12x better is still UNTESTED because SEO-14 never ran. This sprint tests it and then builds on the answer. THE CONTENT DIRECTION IS MEASURED, NOT GUESSED: all 337 ranking queries were classified with the committed intent gate on 02 Sept. The `doa` family is 221 impressions, 100% document intent, 4.5% CTR - and sits at AVERAGE POSITION 21.7, which is enormous headroom on our own best-converting territory. Against that, `mas kahwin` is 1,046 impressions (40% of the site), 0% document intent, 0.6% CTR, across 39 of our 92 articles. We built 39 articles in the cluster that cannot convert and 10 in the one that does. So: deepen ucapan-doa (CONT-17), build out nikah-undang-undang where lafaz taklik sits at position 9.0 with zero clicks and rukun at 22.3 (CONT-18), and finish the composition DES-03 already drew (UI-19's rail). 26 document-intent queries currently carry impressions and zero clicks. ADDED 02 Sept at the owner's request: UI-20, the favicon - which is a PINK serif 'H' from the retired Plum Forward palette, on a site whose brand is a warm-neutral monotone, and which is not any mark in the brand registry. brand-assets.ts already names the monogram as 'the only mark that survives a favicon'.

items.title: A soft-failed pillar render is cached forever - one DB blip can pin an empty topic hub indefinitely
items.dod: renderPillarPage catches a failed or timed-out getPillarView and renders SUCCESSFULLY with clusters: [], while the route declares revalidate = false. Next therefore has a valid page to cache and caches it indefinitely; only revalidateTag('articles') or revalidateTag('inspire-categories') from an admin write can clear it, and there is no time-based revalidation to heal it. Done when a degraded render is provably not persisted as the long-lived ISR entry - either re-throw after logging so Next does not cache it, or set a short revalidate window on the degraded path - demonstrated by forcing the deadline miss and showing the next request re-renders rather than serving the empty page. The same soft-fail pattern exists on the category grid route; say whether it has the same exposure. Mitigated but NOT fixed by UI-05, which added an empty state so the page says something instead of rendering a bare div.

evidence.claim: A degraded render of /artikel/[category] is no longer served — and therefore no longer cached — as a successful empty page.
